# Secrets a workflow references that DELIBERATELY do not exist (SEC-101 / SEC-102).
#
# GitHub expands an undefined secret to the empty string, silently. Most of the
# time that is a defect. Sometimes it is the designed behaviour: several report
# sections detect the empty value and render "DATA UNAVAILABLE" with the missing
# variable named, which is exactly what the Workflow & Backup Integrity Policy
# asks for — never a silent green.
#
# This file is where that distinction gets written down. Every entry needs a
# reason AND a Jira key, enforced by scripts/check-workflow-secret-refs.py.
# An absence nobody is tracking is not a decision.
#
# Format:   SECRET_NAME  # why the absence is safe, and what happens (TICKET)
#
# Secrets that DO exist live in .github/known-secrets.txt, generated verbatim
# from `gh secret list`. Never hand-edit that file to silence this check.

# --- Weekly report, Section 20 "Cost Spotcheck" -----------------------------
# probe() marks the provider unavailable and the shaper renders DATA UNAVAILABLE
# naming the missing variable. Cost reporting is a scaffold; no provider API is
# consumed deeply yet.
VERCEL_API_TOKEN            # cost spotcheck renders DATA UNAVAILABLE naming the var (SEC-102)
SUPABASE_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN   # cost spotcheck renders DATA UNAVAILABLE naming the var (SEC-102)

# --- Weekly report + email-as-prompt: Jira reads ----------------------------
# Guarded by an explicit `[ -z ... ]` test that sets skipped_reason, so the
# section renders DATA UNAVAILABLE with the specific cause rather than a zero.
ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN_READONLY  # explicit -z guard -> DATA UNAVAILABLE with reason (SEC-102)
ATLASSIAN_USER_EMAIL          # explicit -z guard -> DATA UNAVAILABLE with reason (SEC-102)
ATLASSIAN_DOMAIN              # explicit -z guard -> DATA UNAVAILABLE with reason (SEC-102)

# --- Authed E2E: Cloudflare WAF bypass --------------------------------------
# NOT benign — a real open blocker, listed here so it stays visible rather than
# failing every PR. Cloudflare bot protection 403s the GitHub runner IP
# (CLAUDE.md gotcha #7), so the authed E2E journey cannot run from CI at all
# until the founder adds a CF WAF skip rule and provisions this header/secret
# pair. Until then that coverage is UNVERIFIED, not passing.
E2E_CF_BYPASS_HEADER        # open blocker: needs CF WAF skip rule, founder-provisioned (SEC-102)
E2E_CF_BYPASS_SECRET        # open blocker: needs CF WAF skip rule, founder-provisioned (SEC-102)
